heading: When this combination makes sense
text:
### When this combination makes sense [LNOG.6.3]

`linear_scan: false` with `logical: false` is appropriate for:

- High-frequency event detection where each fact is processed
  independently (no cross-schema correlation needed).
- Streaming aggregations where all joins are within a single schema
  (series patterns are single-schema by construction).
- Deployments where operational simplicity and deterministic retraction
  cost are priorities and cross-schema correlation is not required.

It is not appropriate for any program that needs to correlate facts
across two or more schemas — those programs need either multi-pattern
rules (requiring `linear_scan: true`) or `logical` facts (banned by
`logical: false`).
